newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ford FY 96 estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ford FY 96 estimate cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it cut its 1996 earnings estimate on Ford Motor Co to $3.55 per share from $3.70 after the company detailed problems in its Latin America operations.
-- Cut Q3 estimate to $0.50 from $0.60 and Q4 estimate to $1.15 from $1.20.
-- Left 1997 estimate of $4.50 per share in place for now, but noted Latin American weakness "could last well into next year."

-- Kept buy rating on shares, citing high dividend yield, "which together with an asset value that effectively places a zero valuation on the company's core automotive unit should help minimize downside risk to (a fall in stock price to) perhaps $28-29 per share."
